leadership.name: Shah Md Mahtubuddin Al Mamun
leadership.bio: Began his career in the export business immediately after post-graduation, building the company's international trade base through premium Bangladeshi products — mustard oil, carbonated beverages, bay leaf, muri, dried chilli, energy drinks, muri toast, aromatic rice and flattened rice — exported directly to Japan, Canada, France, the Netherlands, Malaysia and Saudi Arabia. Recognising the growing demand for premium imported food in Bangladesh, he expanded into the import sector, where World Club now supplies superstores, department stores, Army CSD stores and 5-star hotels and restaurants nationwide.

leadership.name: AKM Fariduzzaman
leadership.bio: Joined World Club in mid-2021 after serving as Head of Supply Chain at a renowned apparel manufacturing group in Bangladesh. He brings deep leadership strength in management, teamwork, supply chain, business development, lead-time follow-up and logistics management, developed over a career spanning several companies in supply chain and logistics.
